acceptance: sql-execution-evidence uses a digest-pinned Postgres 17 image from the ghcr.io mirror or another authenticated registry.
Workflow tests that pin the image are updated, and a CI run shows the job pulling from the mirror.
context: UPDATE 2026-10-23: the same rate limit fails the Nightly Validation postgres-integration job: runs 39586739797 (2026-10-21) and 39765452451 (2026-10-22) failed with 'Error response from daemon: toomanyrequests: Data limit exceeded' / 'Docker pull failed'. Any fix should cover nightly.yml's Postgres pull too.
description: The `sql-execution-evidence` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` uses the service image `public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:17@sha256:2d2b8998...` (`:1283`), pulled anonymously from ECR Public. On PR #3264 (run 39778950173, 2026-10-22) the pull failed with `toomanyrequests: Data limit exceeded`; the job failed, and the required `core` aggregate failed with it. A rerun passed. `docker-integration.yml` already avoids this: its `mirror-postgres` job copies Postgres to `ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/postgres` through `mirror-ci-images.yml`, and its jobs pin the mirrored digest (today Postgres 18).
